text:
maria: Heads-up thread for Vela-v1 q5k anomalies seen on the nightly locale grid. Short: unexpected ZWSP-like gaps in JA/KO detok, Arabic paren mirror flips to fullwidth variants, and rare prefix echo with kvcache+batches.

kenji: Can you drop a tiny repro + exact flags?

maria: Repro + config below. Tokenizer: tkv2 locale_heuristics=on. Quant: q5_k per-channel (no shared centroids). Serving: kvcache=enabled, batch=8, batch_timeout_ms=10, max_seq=1024.

maria: ```
# JA input
今日は、天気がいいですね。
POST /v1/generate {"model":"vela-v1","prompt":"<JA> 今日は、天気がいいですね。","quant":"q5_k"}
```

taylor: Output sample (q5k, detok):
`\u4eca\u65e5 \u306f \u3001 \u5929 \u6c17\u304c\u3044\u3044\u3067\u3059\u306d \u3002`

mei: fp16 baseline (same prompt) -> `今日は、天気がいいですね。` (no gaps).

kenji: Are those actual U+200B/ZWS characters or spaces inserted by detok? Token-id mapping?

maria: Pre-detok token-id tables match up to pos 14, divergence thereafter. Pre-detok mapping shows no explicit U+200B mapping; looks like detok produced spacing.

mei: Arabic example: input `قال: (هذا مثال)` -> q5k detok -> `قال: ）هذا مثال（` (paren positions flipped and appear fullwidth).

kenji: Hypotheses: (1) quantization introduces token jitter around neutrals so bidi reordering picks different mirrorings; (2) detok's normalization/bidi ordering runs in a different sequence and amplifies the change; (3) kernels accidentally reorder neutral-class tokens.

taylor: I ran deterministic replays: fp16 stable, q5k shows non-deterministic token jitter near neutral runs even with fixed seed. That suggests model-side noise.

maria: Also observed prefix-repeat when batch>1 + kvcache: example log: `repeat_detected sample=vela-az-900 step=46 token=1273 matches earlier token`. Occurred 5x in 2k samples.

ops-bot: Canary: vela-staging-11 job 2026-03-22T08:40 finished. 6/120 locale tests failed. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/vela-v1/q5k/4332109999/.

kenji: Plan: (A) kernel parity run (fp16 kernels on quant path) to check for reordering (ETA 4h), (B) run q5k-shared centroids and q8 baseline in parallel (ETA 6h), (C) detok pipeline ordering test (run bidi before/after normalization) (ETA today), (D) collect kvcache traces for prefix-repeat correlation.

taylor: I'll produce top-30 token-id divergences with unicode bidi classes and the first point-of-divergence mapping. That should show if neutrals shift across boundaries.

mei: Metric deltas (nightly): JA BLEU 28.1->24.0, KO BLEU 26.0->22.7, AR paren F1 0.990->0.906. Pref-repeat rate: 0/1000 (fp16) -> 8/1000 (q5k, batched).

maria: Uploaded failing eval ids: `eval-2026-03-22-ja-gap-01`, `eval-2026-03-22-ar-paren-02`, `eval-2026-03-22-prefrep-03`. s3://redwood-evals/vela-v1/q5k/4332109999/diffs.tar.gz

kenji: Kicking off parity jobs now (job ids: parity-4332, q5k-shared-4333). Will post logs and short scripts to extract kvcache traces.

taylor: helper to map bidi class: ```python
import unicodedata
def classes(s):
    return [(c, unicodedata.bidirectional(c)) for c in s[:80]]
```

mei: tagging @product - if default quant causes visible spacing/parens we must delay defaulting to q5k on Dedicated.

maria: Thanks. Ping me if you find any blocking reproductions; I'll assemble a short customer-facing summary if needed. :mag_right:
